title: Molecular Biology
description: Exploring DNA and RNA structure, replication, transcription, gene expression, genetics and the molecular mechanisms that connect sequence to cellular function.

title: Nanobiotechnology
description: Exploring nanoscale materials and biological interfaces, with interest in optical sensing, functional nanomaterials and bio-enabled technologies.

title: Computational Biology
description: Learning how computation, data analysis and automation can support biological discovery, interpretation and reproducible research workflows.

title: Bioinformatics
description: Building familiarity with sequence-centric thinking, biological databases, computational tools and data-driven approaches to life-science questions.

title: Laboratory Science
description: Developing practical understanding of microscopy, microbiology, staining, observation, documentation and experimental workflows.

title: Scientific Communication
description: Turning complex scientific ideas into clear presentations, visual explanations, organized notes and accessible digital resources.
